name: exploratory-server
description: Search and read notes, dashboards, charts, analytics and data published on Exploratory, and query data on the server.

interface.longDescription:
Connect to Exploratory to find and read notes, dashboards, slides, charts, analytics, and data published on exploratory.io. Search content available to your signed-in account, summarize reports with source links, retrieve chart images and the data behind them, and read published statistical results.

For published data, inspect column definitions and example rows, calculate grouped totals and rankings, and join related data items on the server. The included skill guides the AI to check data definitions, use server queries for totals, and report the published filters, parameter state, and data date when available.

Sign in with an Exploratory account through OAuth. Access follows the item's sharing and data-download permissions. The plugin does not edit or publish Exploratory content. When you request a CSV or Parquet export with dataframe_export, the server creates a temporary file and a download link that only the same signed-in user can open. Access permissions are checked again at download time. The link expires after 15 minutes by default; use the expires_at value returned with the link for its actual expiry.

By default, the Server MCP records each data query in an access log, including who made it, when, which data item was accessed, the operation, and the outcome. For structured queries and exports, the log can also store the query request, including filter values; requests over 10,000 characters or requests that cannot be serialized are omitted. OAuth client details, query metadata, and, for access other than public access, email and IP address may also be recorded. Results are returned to your AI client and handled under that client's own privacy and data-handling policies.

This plugin connects to the Exploratory Server MCP. Exploratory Desktop and Node.js are not required. Creating or editing local Exploratory projects requires a separate Desktop integration.
capabilities: Search and read published Exploratory items
